aaii-sentiment: Shows the weekly AAII Investor Sentiment Survey split into bullish, neutral and bearish readings, with eight-week averages.
ai-regulation: Tracks AI laws and regulatory actions by country in timeline, upcoming-deadline, regulation and country views, from a list kept in the app's config.
breakthroughs: Scrolls a ticker of science headlines from feeds such as ScienceDaily, Nature News, New Scientist and Live Science.
china-activity-nowcast: Compares China's official activity releases with logistics, commodity and market proxies to show where the two agree or diverge.
china-corridors: Tracks four China logistics corridors using port, aviation, hazard, energy and trade data from sources such as IMF PortWatch and UN Comtrade.
commodities-news: Lists commodity market headlines from news feeds including Oil & Gas, Gold & Metals, Agriculture and Commodity Trading.
cross-source-signals: Lists severity-ranked signals combined from separate datasets such as thermal escalation, GPS jamming, unrest, cyber threats, earthquakes and markets.
crypto-heatmap: Shows a heatmap of crypto sectors colored by their 24-hour price change, computed from CoinGecko market data.
crypto-news: Lists cryptocurrency headlines from news feeds including CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block and Decrypt.
deduction: Answers a scenario question you type with an AI analysis of likely timeline and impact, optionally scoped to a region and an analytical framework.
digest: Lists the five newest stories from the positive news feeds, each with an AI-generated summary of 50 words or fewer.
economic-news: Lists economy headlines on data releases, trade and housing from news feeds Economic Data, Trade & Tariffs and Housing Market.
energy-crisis: Lists government energy-saving and consumer-support measures by country from the IEA 2026 Energy Crisis Policy Response Tracker.
energy-disruptions: Lists disruption events on pipelines and storage facilities, newest first, from a curated log you can filter by type and ongoing status.
energy-risk-overview: Shows Strait of Hormuz status, EU gas storage fill, the Brent crude price and the count of active energy disruptions as summary tiles.
events: Lists upcoming technology conferences and events from the Techmeme events calendar and dev.events, with an option to show each on the map.
fear-greed: Scores market sentiment as a composite of ten weighted categories such as volatility, breadth and credit, shown beside the CNN Fear & Greed reading.
fuel-shortages: Lists confirmed and watch-level fuel shortages by country and fuel product from a curated registry, ranked by strength of evidence.
gcc-investments: Lists Saudi and UAE investments in critical infrastructure worldwide from a built-in database, filterable by investor and sector and linked to the map.
global-procurement: Lists open public tenders from SAM.gov, EU TED, UK Contracts Finder, CanadaBuys and the World Bank, searchable by buyer, country and source.
intel: Lists defense and foreign-policy news and analysis from sources such as Defense One, The War Zone, Foreign Policy and RAND.
latest-brief: Shows the cover card of your latest World Monitor Brief, the AI-written intelligence digest, with a link to read the full edition.
live-news: Streams live news video channels from YouTube, such as Bloomberg, Sky News, DW and Al Jazeera, in a switchable player.
map: Maps conflicts, military activity, hotspots, nuclear sites, sanctions, weather and outages as toggleable layers on a WebGL map with an optional 3D globe.
market-breadth: Charts the share of S&P 500 stocks trading above their 20, 50 and 200-day moving averages, computed from a TradingView screener scan.
markets-news: Lists market and business headlines from news feeds including CNBC, MarketWatch, Yahoo Finance and Reuters Markets.
material-events: Lists recent SEC Form 8-K material-event filings with company, item code, description, filing time and a link to the filing on sec.gov.
national-debt: Shows government debt by country as a running clock built on IMF World Economic Outlook data and US Treasury FiscalData, sortable by debt-to-GDP.
news-market-correlation: Charts GDELT news volume on a topic against an asset's price and reports their Pearson correlation and which series leads by up to six hours.
nq-catalysts: Lists high-impact US economic releases for the next week and upcoming earnings from Nasdaq heavyweights such as Apple, Microsoft and NVIDIA.
nq-news: Lists Nasdaq futures and tech headlines from news feeds including Reuters Nasdaq Futures, Nasdaq-100 & QQQ, Federal Reserve and Semiconductors.
nq-pulse: Shows quotes for Nasdaq-100 futures, the QQQ fund, the VXN volatility index and the 10-year Treasury yield as context, not execution-grade data.
other-tokens: Lists prices and 24-hour and 7-day performance for alternative crypto tokens outside the major-cap tiers, using CoinGecko data.
pipeline-status: Lists oil and gas pipelines from a curated registry, each badged flowing, reduced or offline, with a detail drawer of disruption events.
polymarket: Lists prediction markets from Polymarket and Kalshi with the yes/no probability, trading volume and closing date of each question.
positive-feed: Lists positive news as image cards with category filters, from feeds such as Good News Network, Positive.News and Reasons to be Cheerful, plus GDELT.
progress: Charts long-run World Bank data on life expectancy, literacy, child mortality and extreme poverty as area charts.
regional-intelligence: Shows a per-region intelligence snapshot covering regime, balance of power, key actors, scenarios, transmission paths and a watchlist.
species: Shows species recovery stories with photos, IUCN category badges and population trend sparklines, curated from sources such as USFWS, IUCN and WWF.
spotlight: Shows the newest humanity-and-kindness story from the positive news feeds as a featured card with photo, excerpt and map location.
storage-facility-map: Lists gas storage sites, strategic petroleum reserves, LNG terminals and crude tank farms from a curated registry with an operational status badge.
threat-timeline: Charts the daily count of intelligence insights by threat level over the last seven days, with a trend readout and alerts grouped by severity.
toronto-safety: Shows reported crime occurrences and annual calls-attended totals from official Toronto Police Service datasets; it is not live dispatch.
windy-webcams: Shows the Windy webcams you pin from the map as embedded live players, with controls to pause or unpin each stream.
